kind.description: Engagement type: real client folder or portfolio build.

delivery_lane.description: Execution surface. tool-built-bi = ClickUp Portfolio Projects + kit deploy.

kit.description: Required when delivery_lane is tool-built-bi. Must match a kit manifest name.

source.description: Required when kind is client. CRM acquisition source (e.g. Upwork).

engagement_type.description: Service shape — distinct from delivery_lane (where work executes).

project_path.description: Relative vault path. Defaults to 02_Clients/<name> or 04_Portfolio/<name>.

starting_phase.description: Resume point. Validator checks prior-phase artifacts exist.

status.description: Client CRM status. Defaults to prospect (client) or active (portfolio).

include_portfolio_readout.description: When true, portfolio builds keep Phase 7 (readout / case-study pass).
